companyDescription: AI-enabled drug discovery platform — phenomics + generative chemistry pipeline, partnered with Sanofi, Roche/Genentech, and Citeline
priceNote: Trading near the middle of its $2.77–$7.18 52-week range; consolidating ahead of Aug 11 earnings and 2H26 pipeline readouts
summary: Recursion is a binary-catalyst platform biotech: multiple 2H26 readouts (REC-4881 FDA pathway update, REC-1245 Phase 1 data, REC-7735/REC-102 go/no-go decisions) could re-rate the stock sharply if the AI-discovery thesis is validated, but heavy cash burn and early safety signals in REC-1245 keep downside real. Size this as 2-5% of portfolio max — a moonshot sleeve, not a core position.

catalysts.name: REC-4881 FDA Pathway Update (FAP)
catalysts.description: FDA feedback on potential registrational study design for REC-4881 in familial adenomatous polyposis — the single biggest near-term value driver per bull case commentary

catalysts.name: REC-1245 Phase 1 Dose-Escalation Data
catalysts.description: DHALIA solid-tumor trial data update; early safety signals already reported, so the full data set is a swing factor both ways

catalysts.name: Citeline AI-Clinical-Trials Partnership Scale-Up
catalysts.description: Expanded partnership targeting $100M in inflows by end-2026, plus continued Sanofi (5th milestone, $134M to date) and Roche/Genentech phenomap milestones

risks: Heavy cash burn (guided <$390M FY26) — even with ~$754M cash and runway into early 2028, dilution risk resurfaces if milestones slip or additional financing is needed
REC-1245 already flagged early safety signals in the DHALIA solid-tumor trial; a negative full readout would undercut the pipeline's most advanced differentiated asset
Sanofi/Roche/Genentech partnership milestones are lumpy and non-guaranteed — a wind-down or deprioritization of any program would remove a key revenue and validation source
Analyst sentiment is split and skeptical of platform value: consensus skews Hold, with a recent Morgan Stanley target of just $5.50 vs. legacy highs near $33

estimateDates.note: Watch for REC-4881 FDA pathway commentary and REC-1245 data timing

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Pre-revenue clinical-stage biotech valuation is driven far more by binary data/regulatory readouts than by Fed policy; direct rate sensitivity is low
macroRisk.inflationNote: Inflation has minimal direct read-through to RXRX's cost structure beyond general R&D/compute cost inflation
macroRisk.sectorImpact: Biotech risk appetite and small-cap financing conditions do correlate with the rate-cut cycle — cheaper capital markets make it easier for pre-revenue names like RXRX to raise without excessive dilution, an indirect tailwind if cuts continue into 2H26
macroRisk.summary: Fed risk is a secondary factor here; the primary driver of RXRX's price is idiosyncratic pipeline/partnership catalyst risk, not macro

entryStrategy.verdict: Speculative moonshot sleeve only — size 2-5% of portfolio max, scale in ahead of the Aug 11 earnings and 2H26 catalyst cluster

catalystSpot.preRunup: Micro/small-cap platform biotechs with a dated FDA-pathway or pivotal-data event typically see speculative positioning build 2-4 weeks pre-event, though magnitude is smaller than a full Phase 3 readout since pathway feedback is directional, not efficacy-confirming

postWin.note: Scaled down from full Phase 3 readout comparables (ABVX +586%, SLS +210%) since an FDA pathway-clarity update is a smaller, less binary catalyst than confirmed efficacy data
postWin.exampleDate: Jul 2025 (ABVX ABTECT Phase 3) / Aug 2025 (SLS Phase 3 melanoma)

postLose.note: Negative FDA feedback or a failed readout in this space has produced severe drawdowns — REPL fell ~64% on a Complete Response Letter, IOBT fell ~77% when FDA required an additional trial

spotSizing.reason: Multiple binary 2H26 catalysts plus an already-flagged early safety signal in REC-1245 keep conviction moderate — 3% reflects real upside optionality without overexposure to a single clinical/regulatory outcome

stopPreCatalyst.note: If support breaks before any 2H26 catalyst lands, thesis (platform momentum) is weakening

stopPostCatalyst.note: If REC-4881/REC-1245 news disappoints, exit on confirmation — do not average down into a broken thesis

comparableCases.event: Phase 3 ABTECT topline data (obefazimod, ulcerative colitis)
comparableCases.note: Small/mid-cap biotech re-rated overnight on a clean Phase 3 win — illustrates the scale of upside a validating data readout can unlock for a platform/pipeline biotech

comparableCases.event: Pivotal Phase 3 melanoma vaccine data (IO102-IO103 + Keytruda combo)
comparableCases.note: Partnership-adjacent (Merck's Keytruda) pivotal data win — comparable structure to RXRX's Sanofi/Roche-backed pipeline being validated by clinical or regulatory data

th.summary: Recursion เป็นหุ้น biotech แบบ binary-catalyst: มี catalyst หลายตัวใน 2H26 (FDA pathway update ของ REC-4881, ข้อมูล Phase 1 ของ REC-1245, การตัดสินใจ go/no-go ของ REC-7735/REC-102) ที่อาจดันราคาขึ้นแรงถ้า thesis AI-drug-discovery ได้รับการยืนยัน แต่การเผาเงินสดหนักและสัญญาณความปลอดภัยเบื้องต้นใน REC-1245 ก็ยังเป็นความเสี่ยงด้านลบจริง ควรถือเป็น 2-5% ของ portfolio เท่านั้น — เป็น moonshot sleeve ไม่ใช่ core position

REC-1245 มีสัญญาณความปลอดภัยเบื้องต้นใน DHALIA solid-tumor trial แล้ว หากผลเต็มออกมาแย่จะกระทบ asset ที่ก้าวหน้าที่สุดของ pipeline
Milestone จาก Sanofi/Roche/Genentech ไม่สม่ำเสมอและไม่รับประกัน หากมีการยุติหรือลดความสำคัญโปรแกรมใดจะเสียทั้งรายได้และการยืนยัน thesis
มุมมองนักวิเคราะห์แตกแยกและค่อนข้างสงสัยมูลค่าแพลตฟอร์ม — consensus โน้มเอียงไปทาง Hold โดย Morgan Stanley ให้เป้าเพียง $5.50 เทียบกับจุดสูงสุดเดิมใกล้ $33
